summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a regular quarterly dividend distribution of $0.187 per Class I share of Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund, a business development company. The record date is July 31, 2026, with payment on or about August 24, 2026. It also provides routine updates on net asset value ($25.85 per share), portfolio composition (39 companies, $217.1M fair value), and the status of a continuous public offering. No special-situation event is announced; this is a standard periodic reporting of operational and financial metrics.
